linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux kernel 5.4 or newer, glibc 2.17 or newer (64-bit)
  • Processor: 4th Gen Intel i5 (quad-core) / AMD Ryzen 3 (quad-core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan compatible card with 4GB of VRAM, NVIDIA Geforce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon R7 370
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Linux kernel 5.4 or newer, glibc 2.17 or newer (64-bit)
  • Processor: 7th Gen Intel i7 (quad-core) / AMD Ryzen 5 (quad-core)
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan compatible card with 6GB of VRAM, NVIDIA Geforce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5600XT
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
